target: all original allowlisted clusters at all four stations
measurement: actual persisted FaserSCT_Cluster localPosition/globalPosition/localCovariance/RDO list and detector-element transform
prediction: saved WB125 P mean-z state transported as straight line in global x/y to detector-element z; explicitly not ACTS curve prediction
identity_rule: unique cluster ID, exact allowlist membership, source event/run and station match
closure_rule: independently reconstruct A^T W A and A^T W u from exported rows and compare to WB91 raw_normal/RHS where available
residual_rule: local measurement component 0 minus local straight prediction component 0
primary_success_rule: all primary S3 allowlisted rows have valid measurement/frame and exact export closure; direct residual is reported, no residual PASS cut
unknown_rule: missing EDM object, invalid frame/covariance, missing row, or normal/RHS closure failure is UNKNOWN
